subject: Mutual plan: security gates, DPA language, and retention timeline

Subject: Mutual plan: security gates, DPA language, and retention timeline

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the time earlier. As discussed, I wanted to capture the MAP items specific to security gates so your procurement and engineering teams can validate and sign off. Attached is a short runbook that pulls the SOC 2 artifacts we typically share and an extracted SIG/CAIQ summary. Key asks from FinBridge we noted: SOC 2 report (most recent), SIG/CAIQ answers for our hosted API, DPA language around data handling/retention, and confirmation of embedding/PII handling.

Quick proposal for milestones (high level):
- SIG/CAIQ extract delivered: 3 business days
- SOC 2 report (redacted) delivered: 7 business days
- DPA draft back-and-forth: target countersign within 2 weeks of first draft
- Close/PO: target within 30 days of countersigned DPA

Can you confirm this cadence works for your team? I asked Karthik to pull the SOC 2 snapshot and a short note on retention options (default 30 days, configurable up to 365).

Attachments: redwood-map-runbook-v1.pdf (overview), SIG-CAIQ-extract.xlsx (answers)

Thanks —
Elliot Price

On Wed, Jul 28, 2027 at 9:12 AM Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the time earlier...

Hi Elliot —

Appreciate the summary. A few clarifying questions from FinBridge security/procurement before we lock the MAP dates:  
1) Embeddings & PII: do you persist embeddings derived from customer-provided text by default? If so, what retention options are supported and where is the data stored (region/cloud)?
2) Third-party processing: does Redwood send tokens or kv-cache content to any third-party analytics or monitoring vendors?
3) SOC 2: we need the latest Type II report or an SOC 2 letter with scope and date. Can you confirm the audit period?
4) SIG/CAIQ: would prefer a completed CAIQ, but the extract you mentioned is fine — will your security team sign an attestation that the answers are current as of a given date?
5) DPA: procurement has a few standard asks — limited use clause, return/deletion on termination, subprocessor list and 30/60/90-day notification windows. Please flag any clauses that are non-negotiable from Redwood's side.

Also, we run a procurement freeze week Aug 9–13; if we aim to have countersign by Aug 12 we may still hit legal review before the freeze. Can you confirm whether you can provide the SOC 2 redaction and SIG extract by Aug 5?

Thanks —
Samantha Cole
Security & Procurement, FinBridge
samantha.cole@finbridge.com | +1 617 555 0440
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@finbridge.com>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-29T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan: security gates, DPA language, and retention timeline

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the detailed list. Short answers up front, then a proposed close timeline and deliverables.

1) Embeddings & PII:
- Default: embeddings derived from customer inputs are retained for 30 days to support caching and vector-reuse optimizations.
- Options: customers can choose (a) zero-retention (no embedding persistence), (b) 30/90/180/365 day retention, or (c) customer-managed retention via private deployment + KMS so data never leaves their VPC.
- Storage: data is stored in our US regions by default (us-west-2). Region can be locked via Dedicated/Private deployment.

2) Third-party processing:
- We do not forward token streams or user payloads to external analytics vendors. Operational telemetry (metrics) is aggregated and never includes raw prompt/response content.

3) SOC 2:
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report covering the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-06-30. Estimated delivery to you by 2027-08-05 (redacted PDF).

4) SIG/CAIQ:
- The attached SIG-CAIQ-extract.xlsx is current as of 2027-07-27. We will add an attestation line to the extract and include the signer.

5) DPA clauses:
- Non-negotiable: limited-use for service delivery, security incident notification timelines (we accept 72 hours for confirmed incidents).
- Flexible: retention windows and subprocessors can be adjusted; we provide a standard subprocessor list and onboarding procedure.

Proposed MAP milestones (concrete):
- 2027-07-29: Deliver SIG extract with attestation (attached)
- 2027-08-05: Deliver redacted SOC 2 Type II (PDF)
- 2027-08-06: Redwood sends DPA first-draft to FinBridge (DocuSign-template)
- 2027-08-12: Target countersign (FinBridge procurement permitting)
- 2027-08-18: PO/Close (target)

Attachments: SIG-CAIQ-extract.xlsx, DPA-countertrack-draft.docx

Links: runbook & evidence matrix: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRunbook
HubSpot MAP record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654321 (deal DB-9854)

If the Aug 12 countersign target is at risk due to your freeze window, let us know earliest blocker and we can prioritize the SOC snapshot first.

Best —
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0102

Elliot / Karthik —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and clear milestones. We reviewed the proposed cadence internally and FinBridge can accept the timeline with two notes:  
1) Please prioritize the SOC 2 redaction by Aug 5 as noted — legal will start review immediately upon receipt.
2) For the DPA, procurement prefers the 30/60/90 notification windows; we can accept Redwood's 72-hour incident notification if it is explicitly captured in the DPA annex.

Assuming those are delivered as discussed, procurement is comfortable targeting an Aug 12 countersign (pending no last-minute legal issues). Please send the DocuSign link for the DPA first draft when ready.

Samantha Cole
Security & Procurement, FinBridge
